settings.title: Refund & Return Policy
settings.default_content:
30-Day Thoughtful Trial

We want you to experience our shoulder bag in your daily routine with complete confidence. We offer a 30-day return window from the date of delivery.

Return Eligibility

To be eligible for a full refund, items must be in original condition: unworn, undamaged, with protective dust bag and packaging intact. We provide a prepaid domestic return shipping label with every authorized return request.

Refund Process

Once your returned bag is received and inspected at our workshop (typically within 2 business days of arrival), your refund will be processed to the original method of payment. Credit card refunds typically post within 3 to 5 business days depending on your financial institution.

Lifetime Repair Support

Because our bags are built for longevity, we stand behind the integrity of our stitching and solid brass hardware. Should you experience any manufacturing defect, contact care@ateliervane.com for atelier repair assistance.
